senses.gloss: fringe, border, skirt; trnsf. the bordered garment, (toga prætexta), state garment.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 11b:8">Taan. 11ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 34a:5">Ab. Zar. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>חלוק לבן שאין בו אימרא</he> a white plain frock without border (without official distinction; cmp. toga pura).
